name: 11967 · Shirley, NY
findings: ZIP 11967 (Shirley) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11967 (Shirley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11967 (Shirley) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
